name: Spherical Gaussian Light-Field and Visibility Representation
definition: A rendering technique that represents light fields and illumination-weighted environment visibility as sets of Spherical Gaussians (SGs), optimized via neural network backpropagation and stored in 2D textures for hardware-accelerated lookups.
summary: Spherical Gaussian Light-Field and Visibility Representation is a rendering technique that optimizes SG parameters via neural networks for fewer lobes and higher quality in static scenes.
